# ⚠️ AI-written code: please read

**Moho Power Launcher was written by an AI.** Every line of its code was generated by **Claude**, an AI model made by Anthropic, in conversation with Doug Craven.

This is sometimes called *vibe coding*. Doug designed the tool, decided what it should do, and tested every feature by hand. Claude wrote, debugged and revised the code. **No human programmer has reviewed the code line by line.**

## What that means for you

- **Back up your Moho scripts folder before you first use the launcher.** It copies scripts into that folder and takes them out again.
- The launcher only removes files it put there itself, and keeps a record of each one. Your own scripts are never removed or changed. Even so, a backup is the safe habit.
- The code has been tested in **Moho Pro 14 on Windows only.** Mac and other Moho versions are untested.
- Bugs are likely. If you find one, please open an issue on this repository and describe what you did and what happened.
